name: lib_convexOn_univ_eq_of_bddAbove
statement: {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] (f : E → ℝ) (hf : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f) (M : ℝ) (hM : ∀ x, f x ≤ M) (x y : E) : f x = f y
closed: ∀ {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] (f : E → ℝ) (hf : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f) (M : ℝ) (hM : ∀ x, f x ≤ M) (x y : E), f x = f y
informal: A convex function on a real vector space that is bounded above is constant (Liouville-type property of convex functions). Promoted and generalised from Mathlib2.ana_convex_bddAbove_const_aux1 (the case E = ℝ).
type: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : Module ℝ E] (f : E → ℝ), ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f → ∀ (M : ℝ), (∀ (x : E), f x ≤ M) → ∀ (x y : E), f x = f y
